raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":758,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON ec.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.name = '武汉市' AND e.education = '大专';"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计员工数量","tables":["MYSQL:energy.employee"],"columns":["employee_id"]},{"requirement":"学历为大专","tables":["MYSQL:energy.employee"],"columns":["education"]},{"requirement":"武汉市电力企业","tables":["MYSQL:energy.energy_company","MYSQL:common.administrative_division"],"columns":["company_id","area_id","id","name"]}],"assumptions":["administrative_division 表包含 id 和 name 字段，且武汉市对应 level=2 的记录","员工学历字段 education 中存储的值为中文“大专”"]}
